name: InflatableSheepState
meaning: InflatableSheep.state (+0x106); anim ids and flags from g_inflatableSheepStateTable 0x57b678

name: INFSHEEP_ST_FLAT
meaning: deflated on the ground, anim 0, not solid; pickable (msg 2 -> 4)

name: INFSHEEP_ST_CARRIED_FLAT
meaning: deflated in the Wolf's/Robot's hand, anim 5, no shadow

name: INFSHEEP_ST_FALL_FLAT
meaning: deflated falling to the ground (anim 0); has an Update case but nothing ever enters it

name: INFSHEEP_ST_INFLATING
meaning: msg 0x4600, anim 2; on anim end SetInflated, re-attach, state 4

name: INFSHEEP_ST_CARRIED_INFLATED
meaning: inflated in the Wolf's hands, anim 6, not solid, no shadow

name: INFSHEEP_ST_CARRIED_BY_SAM
meaning: inflated and picked up by Sam, anim 7

name: INFSHEEP_ST_STANDING
meaning: inflated on the ground, anim 6, SOLID; squash / ground-loss / water checks

name: INFSHEEP_ST_FALLING
meaning: inflated falling, anim 6, solid; lands to 6 or floats to 8

name: INFSHEEP_ST_FLOATING
meaning: inflated in a water zone, drifts with the flow

name: INFSHEEP_ST_RESPAWN_HIDDEN
meaning: hidden at home for 0x3000 ticks (3 s)

name: INFSHEEP_ST_RESPAWN_WOBBLE
meaning: drawn with ScnObject_RenderRespawnWobble for 1 s, then state 0

name: INFSHEEP_ST_GRABBED_BY_SAM
meaning: msg 0x23 (script hold), anim 6, solid; no Update case; msg 0x24 releases to 7
